summary: Reviewed the new cross-client voice roster and screen-share work. Authenticated short-lived SSE snapshots are invalidated by signed LiveKit webhooks and recheck server ACL/leases; web and Flutter publish bounded screen thumbnails. Relevant local test suites pass. Live two-account privacy, deployed webhook delivery, physical-device viewer behavior and Windows runtime acceptance remain open.

checks.name: Backend changed-package tests
checks.observation: All five changed backend packages pass, including SSE handler, signed webhook, roster ACL/snapshot and exact Origin bypass tests.

checks.name: Flutter complete test suite
checks.observation: All 270 tests pass, including thumbnail encoding/validation, roster event parsing and workspace integration.

checks.name: Flutter analyzer for application and tests
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter analyze lib test --no-pub
checks.observation: No issues found. Running the analyzer at the desktop root also discovers the standalone QA integration subproject, whose dependencies are intentionally independent; its missing nested package configuration produces warnings, so the application/test scope was analyzed explicitly.

checks.name: Frontend complete test suite
checks.observation: 225 test files and 672 tests pass, including realtime roster, thumbnail, viewer lifecycle and screen control tests.

checks.name: Android release failure in supplied CI log
checks.observation: The supplied run failed because integration_test was present in the generated release plugin registrant but its plugin was unavailable to release compilation. Commit 6990e27 removes integration_test from the main app dev dependencies and keeps the macOS Keychain integration project isolated; current Flutter unit tests pass. A fresh signed Android release workflow was not run as part of this review.

checks.name: Full backend suite and PowerShell contract verifier
checks.observation: The full go test ./... run was interrupted after environment cache/loopback restrictions; all changed packages were then rerun successfully with loopback permission. scripts/verify-contracts.ps1 could not run because pwsh is not installed.

checks.name: Live two-account/server and platform acceptance
checks.observation: No live webhook/SSE delivery, cross-account ACL probe, physical viewer comparison or Windows runtime test was performed.

remaining: Verify roster refresh and privacy with two live accounts, deployed LiveKit webhook delivery and reconnect, screen-thumbnail lifecycle with a remote peer, and native screen-share behavior on Android/macOS/Windows. Run the GitVerse Android release workflow to reconfirm signing and release compilation after the integration_test isolation fix.
